subject: general
question:
Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence and select its correct spelling from the given options.

The remoteness of the location made it difficult for the authoreties to reach out to the people.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"authoreties"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"authorities"**. (अधिकारियों)

 
 
• **Example:** The authorities have taken strict measures to ensure public safety.
 
 
 
• **"Authorities"** refers to people or organizations having power or control in a particular, typically political or administrative, sphere. (अधिकारियों)
 
 
• **Example:** The local authorities are responsible for maintaining the infrastructure of the city.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Locasion** (स्थान): This is also incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"location"**. (स्थान)

 
 
• **Example:** The location of the new restaurant is perfect for attracting tourists.
 
 
 
• **Remotness** (दूरदराज): This is also incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"remoteness"**. (दूरदराज)
 
 
• **Example:** The remoteness of the village makes it a peaceful place to live.
 
 
 
• **Deficult** (कठिन): This is also incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"difficult"**. (कठिन)
 
 
• **Example:** Solving this puzzle is quite difficult.
